site: Workday (Invesco; any tenant whose school list is empty)
class: A required field whose choices do not exist was created anyway, so the form could never be completed
symptom: The run reached My Experience, could not set 'School or University' for either school, and stopped for the owner on every attempt.
root_cause: Invesco's Workday answers its schools call (HTTP 200) with an empty list: every search, even an empty one, shows 'No Items.'. The agent added an Education entry anyway, which makes School, Degree and Field of Study required, then could not choose a school. Education is optional on Workday.
why_tests_missed: Every school fixture offered schools; none was an empty list, and a school missing from a non-empty list was the only case the rule ('left for you') covered.
fix: Before filling the first Education entry the agent opens its School list and reads it three times over a few seconds; if it only ever says 'No Items.' the section is left empty, the entry removed, and EDUCATION_SKIPPED logged. A list that offers schools (even slowly) is filled as before.
prevention: Before creating an entry with required fields, check that the choices those fields need exist; do not create what cannot be finished.
